上游鋰資源：公司通過在全球範圍內的鋰礦資         Upstream lithium resources: The Company’s worldwide lithium resource
源佈局，分別在澳大利亞、阿根廷、愛爾蘭和         footprint, including Australia, Argentina, Ireland, and Qinghai and Jiangxi
中國青海、江西等地，掌控了多處優質鋰礦資         Province in China, enables us to operate several high-quality lithium
源，形成了穩定、優質、多元化的原材料供          resources, which gives us a stable, high-quality and diverse raw materials
應體系。公司就大部分鋰礦資源簽訂了長期採         supply system. The Company has entered into long-term procurement
購協議。公司現用的主要鋰資源為澳大利亞          agreements with regard to a majority of such lithium resources. Lithium
Mount Marion項目。公司通過持續投資上游鋰   resources currently used by the Company are mainly sourced from the
資源公司及簽署長期戰略採購協議，保障與鞏         Mount Marion Project in Australia. The Company has ensured and cemented
固了上游優質鋰原材料的穩定供應。             the stable supply of upstream lithium raw materials with prime quality
                             through continuously investing in upstream lithium resource companies and
                             entering into long-term strategic procurement agreements.

鋰化合物：贛鋒生態系統的核心為鋰化合物業         Lithium compounds: The lithium compounds business segment is the
務板塊，主要產品包括(1)電池級氫氧化鋰，        core of the Ganfeng Ecosystem, mainly including (1) battery-grade lithium
(2)電池級碳酸鋰，(3)氯化鋰，(4)氟化鋰等，    hydroxide; (2) battery-grade lithium carbonate; (3) lithium chloride; (4) lithium
廣泛應用於電動汽車、便攜式電子設備等鋰電         fluoride, etc. Such lithium compounds are widely used as lithium battery
池材料及化學及製藥領域，客戶主要包括全球         materials for electric vehicles, portable electronics, as well as in chemical
電池正極材料製造商、電池供應商和汽車原始         and pharmaceutical fields. Our customers primarily consist of global battery
設備製造廠商。                      cathode material manufacturers, battery suppliers and automobile original
                             equipment manufacturers.

金屬鋰：公司的金屬鋰產品產能排名全球第          Lithium metals: The lithium metals production capacity of the Company
一。公司能夠根據客戶需要生產不同規格型號         ranks the first place globally. The Company is capable of producing lithium
及厚度的金屬鋰錠、鋰箔、鋰棒、鋰粒子、鋰         metals in the form of ingots, foil, rods, particles, alloy powder as well as
合金粉及銅鋰或鋰鋁合金箔，主要用於(1)鋰        copper lithium or lithium aluminum alloy foil in a range of sizes and thickness
電池負極材料；(2)醫藥反應催化劑；(3)合金      according to the customers’ needs, which are mainly used (1) as lithium
及其他工業品材料，客戶包括電池製造商及醫         battery anode materials; (2) as pharmaceutical catalysts; and (3) in alloys
藥企業。金屬鋰原料主要是氯化鋰，來自公司         and other industrial product materials. Our customers consist of battery
鋰化合物業務板塊及鋰電池回收業務板塊的內         manufacturers and pharmaceutical companies. Raw materials of our lithium
部供應，以及從醫藥企業含鋰催化劑溶液中回         metals are mainly lithium chloride from the internal supply of the Company’s
收的氯化鋰。                       lithium compounds and lithium battery recycling business segments as well
                             as lithium chloride recycled from the catalyst solution which we recover from
                             the pharmaceutical companies.

鋰電池：公司大部分使用自鋰化合物業務板塊         Lithium batteries: The Company produces lithium-ion batteries, mainly using
的客戶處採購的負極材料、正極材料及電解液         a majority of anodes materials, cathodes materials and electrolyte solutions
生產鋰離子電池，主要用於電動汽車、各種儲         sourced from its customers of the lithium compounds business segment.
能設備及各種消費型電子設備，包括手機、平         Such batteries are mainly used in electric vehicles, a variety of energy
板、筆記本電腦、TWS耳機、無人機等。同         storage equipment and all kinds of consumer electronic devices, such as
時，公司積極推進固態鋰電池的研發、生產和         mobile phones, tablets, laptops, TWS headsets, drones, etc.. Meanwhile,
商業化應用。                       the Company also proactively carries forward the research, development,
                             production and commercial application of solid-state lithium batteries.

鋰電池回收：電動汽車及消費型電子產品的使         Lithium battery recycling: As the use of electric vehicles and consumer
用必將帶動退役鋰電池處理的社會需求不斷增         electronic products will certainly lead to an escalating social demand for
加，公司開展鋰電池回收業務市場前景廣闊，         treatment of decommissioned lithium batteries, the Company’s lithium
經濟潛力巨大，並可進一步豐富了鋰原料的多         battery recycling business will have a promising market as well as enormous
元化供應渠道，實現鋰、鎳、鈷、錳等金屬的         economic potential. It can also further enrich the diversified supplies of
資源綜合循環利用。公司回收退役鋰電池業務         lithium raw materials from various sources, thus realizing the comprehensive
為電池生產商及電動汽車生產商提供了可持續         recycling of the resources of metals such as lithium, nickel, cobalt,
的增值解決方案，進一步鞏固與來自電池生產         manganese, etc. The Company’s engagement in recycling decommissioned
業務客戶的關係。                     lithium batteries provides battery manufacturers and electric vehicles
                             producers with sustainable value-added solutions, further solidifies our
                             relationships with customers from the battery production business.

     CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT

                                                            過去的2023年，鋰行業風起雲湧、跌宕起伏。雖然我們收
                                                            穫了很多成果，但更重要的是，我們掌握了更多的經驗。


                                                            2024年，我們要對企業進行整頓，精確預測人才需求，精
                                                            確培養後備人才。同時在投資、建設、生產時，要嚴格審
                                                            核各方面的需求，在把握產品質量的同時從更多環節來降
                                                            低產品的平均成本。所以我們研發要先行、思路要先行、
                                                            措施要先行，只有這樣的話，我們才能具備跨越週期的能
                                                            力。



                                                            The past 2023 has been a year of ups and downs in
                                                            the lithium industry. While we have gained a lot, more
                                                            importantly, we have gained more experience.

                                                            In 2024, we need to reorganize ourselves, accurately
                                                            predict talent needs, and precisely cultivate
                                                            reserve talents. At the same time, when investing,
                                                            constructing, and producing, we must strictly review
                                                            the needs of all aspects and reduce the average cost
                                                            of products from more perspectives while ensuring
                                                            product quality. Therefore, we must prioritize the
                                                            research and development with our ideas and
                                                            measures taking the lead. Only in this way can we
                                                            have the ability to overcome the cycle.

           Dutch government            January 2023        Subsidy policy for new   In 2023, a total subsidy amount of EUR99.4 million is available,
                                                              energy vehicles           with EUR67 million allocated for the purchase or lease of

美國政府                  2022年8月簽署，2023             《通貨膨脹削減法案                   2023年1月1日起，將為消費者購買在美國組裝的電動車提供補
                         年1月生效                     (IRA)》                        貼。獲得稅收抵免的電動汽車有兩個本地化條件要求：(1)電
                                                                                 動汽車動力電池廠包含的關鍵金屬原料在美國或在任何與美
                                                                                 國簽訂有效自貿協定的國家提取和加工；或者回收的比例到
                                                                                 2024年1月1日至少達到40%以上，可以獲得3,750美元的稅
                                                                                 收抵免；(2)新能源汽車動力電池在北美製造和組裝的本地化
                                                                                 價值百分比在50%以上，可以獲得另一份稅收抵免3,750美
                                                                                 元。此政策持續時間為10年，即從2022年12月31日到2032
                                                                                 年12月31日。美國還為二手電動汽車提供高達4,000美元

利潤分配政策                  PROFITS DISTRIBUTION POLICIES

      獨立非執行董事的職責是向董事會提供獨立客                               The role of the independent non-executive Directors is to provide
      觀的意見，適當約束及制衡本集團，保護股東                               independent and objective opinions to the Board, giving adequate

董事會多元化政策                          Diversity Policy of the Board

董事會已採納多元化政策，其中載有董事會多              The Board has adopted a diversity policy, which sets out the policy on
元化之方針。董事會持續不斷地尋求提高其運              the diversity of the Board. The Board continuously seeks to enhance its
作效率及保證最高水準的公司治理，並且認識              operation effectiveness and to maintain the highest standards of corporate
到董事會層面的多元化對於保持競爭力及可續              governance and recognizes the vital importance of Board diversity for
發展而言至關重要。在設計董事會組成時，本              maintaining competitive advantage and sustainable development. In
公司已從多方面考慮了董事會多元化問題，包              designing the Board’s composition, the Company has considered the
括但不限於性別、年齡、文化和教育背景、專              Board diversity from a number of perspectives, including but not limited
業經驗、技能、知識、服務期限長短及作為董              to gender, age, culture and educational background, industry experience,
事將需投入的時間等。                        skills, knowledge, length of services and time to be devoted as a Director.

本公司還將不時考慮其自身業務模型和特殊需              The Company will also take into account its own business model and
要。最終決定將基於指定候選人可為董事會帶              special needs from time to time. The ultimate decision will be made based
來的貢獻及長處而做出。董事會力求確保其具              on the contribution and merit that the designated candidates will bring to
有均衡的技能、經驗及觀點多元化，而這些均              the Board. The Board strives to ensure that it has the balance of skills,
為董事會執行其商業戰略以及董事會的有效運              experience and diversity of perspectives that are required to support the
作所需。                              execution of its business strategies and the effective operation of the Board.

                    公允價值計量                                          Fair value measurement

                     本集團在各報告期末，以公允價                                 The Group measures its derivative financial instruments and
                     值計量其衍生金融工具及股權投                                 equity investments at fair value at the end of each reporting
                     資。公允價值是指在計量日，市                                 period. Fair value is the price that would be received to sell
                     場參與者在正常交易活動中銷售                                 an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction
                     資產收到或者清償債務所支付的                                 between market participants at the measurement date. The
                     金額。公允價值計量基於假設銷                                 fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the
                     售資產或清償債務的交易發生於                                 transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place
                     該資產或負債的主要市場，或者                                 either in the principal market for the asset or liability, or in the
                     在缺失主要市場的情況下，發生                                 absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous
                     於在最有利於該資產或負債的市                                 market for the asset or liability. The principal or the most
                     場。主要市場或者最優市場必須                                 advantageous market must be accessible by the Group.
                     是本集團可以參與的市場。資產                                 The fair value of an asset or a liability is measured using the
                     或負債的公允價值乃基於市場參                                 assumptions that market participants would use when pricing
                     與者在釐定資產或負債的定價時                                 the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in
                     所使用的假設計量，並假設市場                                 their economic best interest.
                     參與者以其最佳經濟利益行事。

                     非金融資產公允價值的計量需考                                 A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into
                     慮市場參與者在最優化使用該資                                 account a market participant’s ability to generate economic
                     產或者將其銷售給另一個能夠最                                 benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by
                     優化使用該資產的市場參與者的                                 selling it to another market participant that would use the asset
                     情況下產生經濟利益的能力。                                  in its highest and best use.

                     本集團在不同的情形下使用適當                                 The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in
                     的估值技術，為準確計量公允價                                 the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to
                     值需獲取充足的數據，最大化使                                 measure fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable

             本集團以財務經理為首的財務部門負責                               The Group’s finance department headed by the finance manager
             釐定金融工具之公允價值計量的政策及                               is responsible for determining the policies and procedures for
             程序。財務經理直接向首席財務官及審                               the fair value measurement of financial instruments. The finance
             核委員會報告。在每個報告日，財務部                               manager reports directly to the chief financial officer and the audit
             門分析金融工具的價值變動並釐定在估                               committee. At each reporting date, the finance department analysis
             值中應用的主要輸入數據。估值經首席                               the movements in the values of financial instruments and determines
             財務官審核並批准。估值過程及結果每                               the major inputs applied in the valuation. The valuation is reviewed
             年就中期及年度財務報告與審核委員會                               and approved by the chief financial officer. The valuation process and
             討論兩次。                                           results are discussed with the audit committee twice a year for interim
                                                             and annual financial reporting.

             金融資產及負債的公允價值乃以該工具                               The fair values of the financial assets and liabilities are included
             於自願交易雙方（而非強迫或清算出售）                              at the amount at which the instrument could be exchanged in a
             當前交易下的可交易金額入賬。以下方                               current transaction between willing parties, other than in a forced or
             法及假設被用來估計公允價值：                                  liquidation sale. The following methods and assumptions were used
                                                             to estimate the fair values:

             計息銀行及其他借款以及其他負債的非                               The fair values of the non-current portion of interest-bearing bank
             流動部分的公允價值是通過使用具類似                               and other borrowings and other liabilities have been calculated by
             條款，信貸風險及剩餘期限工具現時可                               discounting the expected future cash flows using rates currently
             得的利率貼現預期未來現金流量計算。                               available for instruments with similar terms, credit risk and remaining
             於2023年12月31日的公允價值變動被                            maturities. The changes in fair value as a result of the Group’s own
             評估為不重大，因為本集團本身對計息                               non-performance risk for interest-bearing bank and other borrowings
             銀行及其他借款並無履約風險。                                  as at 31 December 2023 were assessed to be insignificant.

             上市股本投資的公允價值以市場報價為                               The fair values of listed equity investments are based on quoted
             基礎。指定為按公允價值計量且其變動                               market prices. The fair values of unlisted equity investments
             計入其他全面收益的非上市股本投資的                               designated at fair value through other comprehensive income have

  風險特徵管理其資本架構並進行調整。                 in light of changes in economic conditions and the risk characteristics
  為維持或調整資本架構，本集團可調整                 of the underlying assets. To maintain or adjust the capital structure,
  向股東派付股息、向股東退還資本或發                 the Group may adjust the dividend payment to shareholders, return
  行新股。本集團毋須受任何外部施加的                 capital to shareholders or issue new shares. The Group is not subject
  資本要求所規限。                          to any externally imposed capital requirements.
